summary: Ran `npx -y -p @angular/cli@18 ng update @angular/core@18 @angular/cli@18 --allow-dirty --force` from EFNgApp/EFNgApp/ClientApp on Node 20/npm 10 (after an initial `npm install`, which were not present at hop start), bumping @angular/* to 18.2.14 and the CLI/build-angular toolchain to 18.2.21. The @angular/core migration replaced the deprecated `HttpClientModule` import in app.module.ts with `provideHttpClient(withInterceptorsFromDi())` in the module's providers array (Prettier-style reformatting of the decorator came along with the codemod); the optional `use-application-builder` migration was not applied, keeping the existing webpack-based builder as the smallest correct change. The hop file listed no related packages to bump, so @ngrx/* stayed at ^17.2.0, which installed and built cleanly against Angular 18. Install and build both pass; test fails the same pre-existing way as baseline and every prior hop (angular.json's test target points at a nonexistent root-level styles.css instead of src/styles.css); `npm run build:ssr` (not a required check) still reports the same two pre-existing, unrelated TS typing errors (@types/jasmine, @types/ws), verified present before this hop's changes too, so nothing new regressed.
changes: @angular/core migration: replaced `HttpClientModule` import/usage in src/app/app.module.ts with `provideHttpClient(withInterceptorsFromDi())` in the NgModule providers array
package-lock.json regenerated by npm as part of the update/install cycles
manual_followups: npm install still needs legacy-peer-deps (set project-wide via ClientApp/.npmrc in an earlier hop) because @nguniversal/module-map-ngfactory-loader@7.1.0 declares peers on @angular/core/@angular/platform-server ^7. It should move to an Angular-18-compatible replacement (the @nguniversal scope was merged into @angular/ssr from Angular 17 onward) in a later hop; the .npmrc override can likely be removed once it does.

`npm run test` fails before any spec executes because angular.json's test architect target still points at `styles.css` at the ClientApp root instead of `src/styles.css`; this predates this hop (present since baseline) and was left as-is per the rule that pre-existing failures don't need fixing.

`npm run build:ssr` (not a required check) reports two pre-existing TypeScript errors from @types/jasmine and @types/ws type-definition conflicts; verified present before this hop's changes too, so left as-is.

Angular 18's optional `use-application-builder` migration (moving from the webpack-based builder to the new esbuild/vite-based application builder) was not applied, to keep this hop's change minimal; worth revisiting in a later hop alongside the @nguniversal/@angular-ssr migration since the new builder has first-class SSR support.

@ngrx/* remained on ^17.2.0 for this hop (hop file listed no related packages); it installed and built fine against Angular 18 but should be bumped to the 18.x line in a near-term hop to stay aligned with Angular's major version.
